messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: GPU OOM + container restart loop on serving-runtime (node gpu-42). Symptom: massive prefill of single request causing slab allocation failure and SIGKILL. Runbook matched: prefill-oom. Paging @ben-oncall and @carla-sre — priority P1.

ben-oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Grabbing pod status and logs.

ben-oncall: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpu-42` -> model-vicuna-13b-q4-7f9d restartCount=7, node gpu-42.

carla-sre: Can you paste the last 50 lines of container stdout/stderr? Looking for `cuMemAlloc` / `SIGKILL` lines.

ben-oncall: Logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T20:12:07Z] ERROR runtime: allocation failed: cannot allocate kv slab (requested 18432000 bytes)
[2026-03-17T20:12:07Z] WARN cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T20:12:07Z] ERROR model: prefill length 118k tokens -> attempting KV cache growth
[2026-03-17T20:12:08Z] FATAL runtime: container process exited: signal SIGKILL
```
Restart loop every ~45s.

dmitri-ml: That looks like large contiguous KV slab growth request; quantized Q4 layout + long prefill causes allocator fragmentation -> cuMemAlloc fail then kernel illegal address in some traces. We've seen close patterns but not this exact SIGKILL sequence.

carla-sre: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: clamp extreme prefills, enable aggressive KV eviction, and remove node from rotation.

alice-ops: Cordoning node gpu-42 and draining workloads now: `kubectl cordon gpu-42 && kubectl drain gpu-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

ben-oncall: Node cordoned/drained. Rerouting is happening but some in-flight prefills already failed -> 502s surfaced.

eve-support: How many customers hit errors? We have support tickets piling.

ben-oncall: Quick metrics: failed prefills last 12m: 63; distinct customer keys: 14; top impacted: acme-inc (~27 failures).

eve-support: Drafting customer message: "Transient GPU memory errors affecting long-context requests; mitigations in progress; no model data loss." Holding for timeline.

dmitri-ml: Immediate options (short-term):
1) Hotpatch server env `PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=65536` to clamp extreme requests.
2) Toggle `KV_CACHE_EVICT=aggressive` to permit prefix eviction.
3) If capacity allows, drain heavy requests to larger GPU type.

carla-sre: Applying 1 & 2 as hotpatch to deployment. Ben, please ensure rollout with maxUnavailable=0 to avoid capacity dip.

ben-oncall: Applying patch:
```
kubectl set env deploy/model-vicuna-13b-q4 PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=65536 -n inference
kubectl set env deploy/model-vicuna-13b-q4 KV_CACHE_EVICT=aggressive -n inference
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-vicuna-13b-q4 -n inference --timeout=2m
```
Rollout in progress.

carla-sre: Also requesting +2 nodes added to `inference-large` pool to handle reroute.

alice-ops: Scaling nodepool `inference-large` +2 now. New nodes provisioning (ETA ~4m).

ben-oncall: After env changes and restart: remaining pods show stable restartCount, no new SIGKILLs for 6m. Prefill failure rate falling.

dmitri-ml: Good. Medium-term fixes: adjust slab allocator to avoid contiguous growth; implement chunked prefill streaming into KV cache; add 100k-token prefill regression test to CI.

carla-sre: Creating follow-up ticket INF-2026-gpu-slab-align and assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml. Attaching logs and sample prompt. Scheduling postmortem in 48h after stabilization.

eve-support: Customer update ready: "We identified a GPU memory allocation issue triggered by very large single-request prefill windows. We applied mitigations (temporary token cap + eviction) and traffic is now stable. Engineering is investigating a permanent fix and will follow up with an ETA."

ben-oncall: Sent customer notifications to affected API keys and support. Marking incident state -> mitigation in place.

carla-sre: Handoff to night oncall: dmitri-ml will verify reproducer and monitoring. Ben, add dashboards and sample traces to incident doc. RCA ETA set to 48h.

ben-oncall: Handoff recorded. Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/5099000123 (creating). Metrics: failed prefills down from ~5/min to ~0.3/min.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: P1 -> Mitigated (hotpatch applied). Owners: eng-runtime (carla-sre), eng-ml (dmitri-ml). Postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:

dmitri-ml: I'll run allocator reproducer tomorrow and post initial findings. Leaving lower-threshold alerts to detect regressions.

eve-support: Will follow up with customers after postmortem draft. Thanks all. :pray:

carla-sre: Closing Slack loop. Keep incident doc current and ping me for postmortem review.
